name: rab-react-kit
title: React UI Toolkit
description: React scaffolds for projects, pages, components, and atoms.

items.name: new-action-atom
items.title: New Action Atom
items.description: Creates a tag-neutral CSS skin for interactive elements, including navigation links and controls, with hover, active, persistent is-active, focus and disabled states plus a React link demo.

items.name: new-component
items.title: New Component
items.description: Creates a structural React component with an optional canonical grid and class atoms resolved before any files are written.

items.name: new-container-atom
items.title: New Container Atom
items.description: Creates a reusable CSS container skin scaffold with inset and float surface hooks, metadata and a React demo. Components own layout.

items.name: new-dashboard
items.title: New Dashboard
items.description: Creates a React dashboard by composing New Page, Apply Grid Layout, New Navigation, and Insert Component Into Area. Defaults to a header-main grid with SiteNav in header.

items.name: navigation
items.title: New Navigation
items.description: Creates a React navigation component from rows with id, name, and path. The generated component accepts selected and handleClick, and marks the selected item for accessibility.

items.name: new-effect-atom
items.title: New Effect Atom
items.description: Creates a named CSS effect token alias from an existing float or inset preset, preserving its elevation-token dependency and atom metadata.

items.name: new-grid-atom
items.title: New Grid Atom
items.description: Creates a named CSS grid definition from an existing grid preset using data-grid and data-area selectors, retaining its area names and track topology.

items.name: new-page
items.title: New Page
items.description: Creates a React page with an addressable root construction seat for applying a grid layout and inserting components.

items.name: new-react-project
items.title: New React Project
items.description: Creates a React project from the project scaffold with a minimal or style-guide starter, optional database example and optional UI kit.

items.name: new-sub-component
items.title: New Sub Component
items.description: Creates a structural React component with an optional canonical grid and class atoms resolved before any files are written.
